title: Research: local block splitting excludes 49 mixed-rank patterns
body:
Uniform mode 3 permits at most one regular anchor block. This closes all 28 four-exception and all 21 five-exception patterns left open by [research/kappa-nine/MIXED-RANK-TEST.md](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/blob/b084bc5bc7aaa4ee51aba7e3d668ea3da9af4934/research/kappa-nine/MIXED-RANK-TEST.md). These are regularity patterns inside one remainder-mode branch. The seven six-exception patterns, the all-exception pattern, and all 103 complete remainder-mode branch representatives remain open. No new kappa is claimed.

Review files: [Proof and scope](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/blob/b084bc5bc7aaa4ee51aba7e3d668ea3da9af4934/research/kappa-nine/MIXED-GEOMETRY.md) · [Evidence](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/blob/b084bc5bc7aaa4ee51aba7e3d668ea3da9af4934/research/kappa-nine/mixed-geometry-certificate.json) · [Source pins and credit](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/blob/b084bc5bc7aaa4ee51aba7e3d668ea3da9af4934/research/kappa-nine/MIXED-GEOMETRY.md).

The new algebraic result is a forced local decomposition on every anchor block: the distinguished Y restrictions for outside points 7 and 8 give complementary idempotents. Their paired A ranks and paired B ranks each sum to 2. Two regular blocks force both paired restrictions on a third block to have rank 2, by Douglas Colkitt (@Mister-Meeseeks)'s existing complementary-block lemma. This contradicts the new rank sum. No covariance, common form, positivity, finite-field inference, or nonlinear solver is used.

The six-file package adds the proof, source pins, a graph-certificate builder, an independent replay, a frozen copy of the experimental selection, and the local scope claim. The exact base is [abdc6a7002abdbcd9e21bfc5e1a795784deacfdf](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/commit/abdc6a7002abdbcd9e21bfc5e1a795784deacfdf). A separate live-main note records [PR #1042](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1042) at [ba82555c64e1879e4b7decce28186f208fcb8262](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/commit/ba82555c64e1879e4b7decce28186f208fcb8262); the executable experiment keeps its original pins and does not read the mutable selected record.

```sh
python3 -B -O research/kappa-nine/verify_mixed_geometry.py
```

Expected output: 7 local block certificates, 378 sole-common-block edges, 21 excluded regular pairs, 49 newly excluded exception patterns, 8 remaining patterns, 3 rational controls, and 7 rejected mutations. The replay reconstructs the graph without importing the producer's graph helpers. It also checks all 128 exception sets, a full 42-label Y coordinate control, and exact root enclosures for the inherited optimistic cost profile.

Validation completed:

- Saved and rebuilt certificates are byte-identical; optimized replay passes.
- Twelve focused predecessor tests pass.
- Replay passes on the pinned source files from live main, with its live selection file absent.
- The coordinating AI agent independently replayed the certificate and reviewed the algebraic proof and inherited block-inverse obligation. This is not external human review.
- `git diff --check` passes. Repository-wide `make verify`, full supplier replay, hosted CI, and Lean were not run; no supplier or selected result changes.

The historical dimension-15/five-role relaxed profile passes `a=1/511` but fails `a=1/99`. It is not an implemented producer. A bit-only improvement cannot advance the outer grid while either recorded complex endpoint stays fixed. A useful full construction still needs the remaining geometry, extension to 16 points, a compact charged producer, the copied/ordered transfer interfaces, and a complex counterpart.

Credit: Douglas Colkitt (@Mister-Meeseeks)'s original `kappa-nine` work and complementary-block proof; [PR #1066](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1066) by @woklerx at `2e72784a7908d45511e953c182d42cdcb911e6cb` independently corroborates that inherited lemma. This contribution adds the forced local decomposition and 49 exclusions. The final overlap check at 2026-10-13 18:28 UTC found [PR #1066](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1066) unchanged and no competing extension. Ali Romman (@aliromman) prepared this package with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance. New work is Apache-2.0.
